name: AHB
recent: AHB 近期有多项董事局与委员会人事变动，包括 Datin Poon Lee Fah、Mr Lim Guan Hong 及 Mr Terence Cheah Eu Lee 的委任或辞任。公司于 10 月与 Seri Beskaya Sdn Bhd 签订合资协议，涉及发电机业务，并转移 Grid Engineering Sdn Bhd 的 370 万股。此外，两名执行董事在闭市期间减持股份，公司也因雇员认股计划（ESOS）行使而多次发行新股。
notable: 与 Seri Beskaya Sdn Bhd 签订合资协议，成立特殊目的公司经营发电机、发电系统及相关服务业务，并转移 Grid Engineering Sdn Bhd 的 370 万股。
因雇员认股计划（ESOS）行使，分别于 2026 年 10 月 21 日及 11 月 20 日发行 370,000 股及 1,851,000 股新股。
董事局及多个委员会出现人事变动，涉及 Datin Poon Lee Fah、Mr Lim Guan Hong 及 Mr Terence Cheah Eu Lee。
risks: 两名执行董事 Mr Chow Hung Keey 及 Mr Flavio Porro 于 2026 年 10 月 26 日在闭市期间分别减持 3,500 万股（3.810%）及 3,300 万股（3.592%）普通股。
公司因 ESOS 行使而持续发行新股，可能对每股盈利造成摊薄。
earnings: 截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日季度，公司营收为 13,359,508 令吉，净亏损 6,320,366 令吉，净利率为 -47.3%。营收较上一季度增长 82.1%，但净利率由上一季度的 -0.5% 大幅下降。

recent_en: AHB has seen several board and committee changes, including appointments or resignations of Datin Poon Lee Fah, Mr Lim Guan Hong and Mr Terence Cheah Eu Lee. In October, the company entered into a joint venture agreement with Seri Beskaya Sdn Bhd for the generator business, involving the transfer of 3.7 million shares in Grid Engineering Sdn Bhd. Two executive directors also disposed of shares during the closed period, and the company issued new shares multiple times under its ESOS.
notable_en: Entered into a joint venture agreement with Seri Beskaya Sdn Bhd to establish a special purpose vehicle for the generator sets, power generation systems and related services business, involving the transfer of 3.7 million shares in Grid Engineering Sdn Bhd.
Issued 370,000 and 1,851,000 new shares on 21 October 2026 and 20 November 2026 respectively due to the exercise of options under the ESOS.
Board and committee changes involving Datin Poon Lee Fah, Mr Lim Guan Hong and Mr Terence Cheah Eu Lee.
risks_en: Two executive directors, Mr Chow Hung Keey and Mr Flavio Porro, disposed of 35 million shares (3.810%) and 33 million shares (3.592%) respectively during the closed period on 26 October 2026.
The company continues to issue new shares under the ESOS, which may dilute earnings per share.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2025, revenue was MYR 13,359,508 with a net loss of MYR 6,320,366, representing a net margin of -47.3%. Revenue grew 82.1% quarter-on-quarter, while net margin fell sharply from -0.5% in the previous quarter.
